originalTitle: By the end of 2026, will it be possible to purchase a motorcycle with a solid state battery for <$50k
title: 消费者能否购买低于 5 万美元的固态电池摩托车？
Will a solid-state motorcycle be purchasable below US$50,000?
rules: 原题以 2026 年结束前可以买到符合条件的摩托车为判断对象，价格门槛为 5 万美元。
The original question asks about availability before the end of 2026 with a US$50,000 price ceiling.
interpretation: 购买资格、订单与实际交付并不相同；原描述细则有限，判断前须查看市场创建者的解释。
Availability, ordering and physical delivery differ. The description supplies limited detail; review the creator’s clarifications.

summary: 预测价格低于 5 万美元的固态电池摩托车能否在原题期限内买到；仅七位参与者，规则细节有限。
This asks whether a sub-US$50,000 solid-state motorcycle becomes purchasable by the deadline; activity and rule detail are limited.
checklist: 查价格是否包含原题要求的配置、市场和币种。
Check configuration, jurisdiction and currency against the source rule.
分清可下单、可交付和客户已收到。
核实商品所用电池，不能只引用供应商实验样品。
Verify the product’s battery rather than only a supplier’s laboratory cell.

stage: 送检数据 → 商品验证 → 客户交付
impact: 企业检测资料能减少对实验样品性能的疑问，但本题最终关心商品可得性或客户交付。进展只有在对应到实际车型、电池型号和原题所指购买行为后，才触及交付门槛。
Tests inform sample performance, while this contract concerns availability or delivery. The relevant link requires an identified vehicle, battery and qualifying purchase or receipt.
gap: 当前引用的元素和能量密度测试没有提供非员工客户收车凭证，也不确定交付车型一定采用同一电池。不能把实验确认直接写成商业交付已经完成。
The cited tests do not establish customer receipt or that delivered vehicles use the tested cell. Experimental evidence does not complete the delivery condition.

title: “固态”“无锂”和“能量密度高”，是三个问题
Solid-state, lithium-free and high specific energy are different questions
principle: 固态描述电解质的物态；锂含量是元素组成；Wh/kg 则是放电能量除以质量。锂金属固态电池仍然可以含锂，所以不能从“固态”推出“无锂”。元素分析、充放电测试与材料物相鉴定各自回答不同问题。

Solid-state describes the electrolyte’s physical form; lithium content is elemental composition; Wh/kg is discharge energy divided by mass. A solid-state lithium-metal cell still contains lithium. Composition analysis, electrical tests and phase identification answer different questions.
example: 读 Intertek 报告时，3.4 ppm w/w 可换算为 0.00034%；但样品来自一个电芯的特定组分。读 VTT 报告时，409.3 Wh/kg 对应 +25 °C、0.1C 放电条件。这两组数据不能互相替代，也不能自动外推到整包和批量产品。

The reported 3.4 ppm w/w converts to 0.00034%, for specified parts of one cell. VTT’s 409.3 Wh/kg refers to +25 °C and 0.1C discharge. These measurements are not interchangeable and do not automatically generalize to packs or production batches.
